title: Congolese monkey with mask-like face and strong BO is new to science | New Scientist
description: A black colobus monkey from a remote part of the Congo Basin rainforest, known locally as likweli, is thought to be severely threatened by poaching
author: James Woodford

title: Best treatment for multiple sclerosis may be antivirals | New Scientist
description: Low levels of replicating Epstein-Barr viruses might be the main driver of the autoimmune condition multiple sclerosis. This may mean that targeting them would be as effective as suppressing the immune system, with fewer side effects
author: Michael Le Page

title: Can consciousness be quantum? We may now have an answer | New Scientist
description: A mathematical analysis suggests that the notion of agency, which is a prerequisite for consciousness, cannot be purely quantum in nature
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: Nicotine pouches may cause receding gums | New Scientist
description: Nicotine pouches aren't typically associated with the same health harms as similar products that also contain tobacco, but they have now been linked to receding gums and oral irritation
author: Mattha Busby

title: Queen's powerful smell suppresses rivals in naked mole rat colonies | New Scientist
description: In naked mole rat colonies, only the queen can breed – and now we have found out how she maintains control
author: Michael Le Page

title: Hard but lightweight ‘bio-metal’ material discovered in sea worm jaws | New Scientist
description: Marine bristle worms have jaws made from a mix of proteins and metal ions that may constitute a whole new kind of material, with possible applications in engineering
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan
